C1.claim: the force never exceeds its authority, either way

C2.claim: past the wall (0.95) the force is the full authority up at once

C3.claim: the force never takes back while the reading climbs above the centre

C4.claim: at rest the force points home: down below the centre, up above it, nothing at the centre

C5.claim: for a given velocity the force never falls as the reading rises (no inversion)

C6.claim: at a given reading the force never falls as the climb quickens

C7.claim: inside the band the force changes no faster than kp times the reading (smooth, never a hammer)

C8.claim: the default damping (critical for the muscle's response time) is never negative

P1.claim: every value the plug sends lies inside the cover

P2.claim: a value already inside the cover is sent as it is

V1.claim: an allowed step never reads LOSS against either reference

V2.claim: an allowed step's estimated change is within the allowance against the fresh reference

V3.claim: stepwise, an allowed step stays within the allowance of the cost first measured at native: steps cannot add up

E1.claim: the executed RK4 micro step keeps E in [min(0, (beta - c)/alpha_E), max(1, (beta + c)/alpha_E)]

E2.claim: every RK4 stage of E stays inside that box widened by 0.13

I1.claim: the executed RK4 micro step keeps I_U in [min(I0, F_lo/lambda_I), max(I0, F_hi/lambda_I)] for any bounded drive

S1.claim: the executed RK4 micro step moves S toward S+ and never past it, from any S0 above S-

U1.claim: the drift |f_U| is below the actuator's limit on the whole stage box, so a saturated step moves U toward its target in every RK4 stage

U2.claim: every unsaturated micro step: |e(k+1)| <= (rho + b)|e(k)| + a

U3.claim: the ball |e| <= r* = a / (1 - rho - b) is entered and never left, and it lies inside the basin (|U - sigma| <= BASIN_TOL) and inside the unsaturated region; outside a/(rho - b) the error never changes sign, so U never overshoots its target by more than r*

U4.claim: every saturated micro step moves U toward its target by at least h (u_max - F_D), never past it

U5.claim: from any admissible start the error is inside the basin within n micro steps

B1.claim: the bath's RK4 step is strictly stable for every parameter in the box: the spectral radius of R(hA) is below 1, so the bath stays bounded under the bounded S and forgets its start
